blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Single-image HDR reconstruction requires inferring missing detail while preserving the visible content of an LDR image. Differences in sensor dynamic range and exposure cause LDR images to lose varying amounts of information in shadows and highlights. We present ExpandDiff, a conditional diffusion pipeline that jointly reconstructs clipped shadows and highlights. To account for this variation, we introduce Dynamic Clipping Synthesis (DCS), which randomly samples shadow and highlight clipping percentiles when constructing training inputs from HDR targets. A pixel-space diffusion model guided by spatially-adaptive normalization then predicts perceptually encoded HDR through a bounded output head, reconstructing both clipping directions in one sampling trajectory. On the SI-HDR benchmark, ExpandDiff variants improve HDR reconstruction accuracy by 3.43 dB in PU21-PSNR over the strongest evaluated competing method, and by 7.34 dB under two-sided clipping. The code and supplementary material are available at https://memreandiran.github.io/expanddiff/ .
blocks.zh: 单一图像的HDR重建需要推断出缺失的细节,同时保留一个LDR图像的可见内容. 传感器动态范围的差异和曝光导致LDR图像在阴影和亮点中丢失了不同数量的信息. 我们提出扩展Diff, 一个有条件的传播管道 联合重建剪接的阴影和亮点。 为了解释这一变化,我们引入了动态剪接合成(DCS),在构建来自人类发展报告目标的培训投入时随机抽取阴影并突出剪切百分位数。 一个以空间适应性正常化为指导的像素-空间扩散模型,然后通过一个有界输出头来预测对HDR的感知编码,在一个取样轨迹中重建两个剪接方向. 在SI-HDR基准上,扩展Diff变体提高了PU21-PSNR中的3.43 dB的HDR重建精度,超过了最强的评价相竞方法,在双侧剪接下提高了7.34 dB. 守则和补充材料见https://memerandiran.github.io/expanddiff/。 。 。 。 。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Typical camera sensors capture 8 to 12 stops of dynamic range [ 1 ] , while real scenes can span 20 stops or more [ 2 ] . The sensor’s dynamic range determines the span of scene intensities that can be recorded, while exposure determines where this span lies. LDR images captured with different sensors and exposures can therefore lose different amounts of information in shadows, highlights, or both. Single-image HDR reconstruction must accommodate this variation, inferring plausible detail in regions where information is lost while preserving visible image content. This inference is ill-posed because the missing detail cannot be uniquely determined from the LDR image. Earlier methods emphasize saturated highlights [ 1 , 3 ] or reconstruct HDR through intermediate exposure brackets [ 4 , 5 , 6 ] . We directly predict one HDR image, jointly restoring shadows and highlights under varying clipping levels.
blocks.zh: 典型相机传感器能捕捉到8到12站的动态范围[1],而真实的场景可以跨越20站或超过[2]. 传感器的动态范围决定了可以记录的场景强度范围,而曝光则决定了这一范围的位置。 因此,用不同的传感器和暴露物捕获的LDR图像可能会在阴影,亮度,或两者中失去不同数量的信息. 单一图像的《人类发展报告》重建必须顾及这种差异,在信息丢失而保留可见图像内容的区域推断出合理细节。 这种推论是不正确的,因为缺失的细节不能从LDR图像中独有地确定. 早先的方法强调饱和的要闻[1,3]或通过中间暴露括号重建人类发展报告[4,5,6]. 我们直接预测人类发展报告的一幅图象,在不同的剪接水平下共同恢复阴影和突出。

blocks.en: We present Dynamic Range Expanding Diffusion (ExpandDiff), a pipeline that couples variable clipping during training, spatial LDR guidance, and perceptually encoded HDR prediction. How much a capture is clipped varies from image to image, and the model is not told it at inference. To account for variation in clipping across real captures, we introduce Dynamic Clipping Synthesis (DCS): a training strategy that randomly samples shadow and highlight clipping levels when constructing LDR guidance from HDR targets. DCS exposes a single model to varying amounts of information loss at both ends of the dynamic range, encouraging reconstruction across diverse clipping conditions. We adapt the RGB-guided RAW-Diffusion backbone [ 7 ] to predict HDR RGB images. The backbone uses spatially-adaptive normalization (SPADE) [ 8 ] to inject LDR features into the diffusion network, so our model conditions the diffusion process in pixel space rather than through the conditioning latent of [ 9 ] or the compressed latent space of [ 6 , 10 , 11 ] .
blocks.zh: 我们提出动态范围扩展传播(Expand Diff),这是在培训、空间LDR指导以及概念上编码HDR预测时可变剪接的管道。 被剪取的捕捉量因图像而异,模型不被推断出来. 为了说明真实捕捉中剪接方式的变化,我们采用了动态剪接合成(DCS):一种培训策略,在从人类发展报告目标中构建LDR指导时随机抽取阴影并突出剪接水平. DCS将单一模型暴露在动态范围的两端,信息损失程度不一,鼓励在不同剪接条件下进行重建. 我们调整了RGB制导的RAW-Difusion主干线[7],以预测HDR RGB的图像. 骨干采用空间适应性常态化(SPADE)[8]将LDR特征注入扩散网络,因此我们的模型将扩散过程作为像素空间的条件,而不是通过[9]的潜能或[6,10,11]的压缩潜能空间.

blocks.en: Finally, to construct the training target, we encode the HDR target with PU21 [ 12 ] , a perceptually uniform encoding of absolute luminance in which equal differences in its units are equally visible. This allocates more of the bounded output range to dark intensities and prevents the loss function from getting dominated by highlights. The model retains Gaussian diffusion training and reconstructs shadows and highlights jointly in a single 24-step sampling trajectory.
blocks.zh: 最后,为了构建培训目标,我们用PU21[12]编码了《人类发展报告》目标,这是一种概念上统一的绝对亮度编码,其单位的等同差异同样可见。 这样可以将更多被限制的输出范围分配到黑暗强度上,并可以防止损失功能被亮点所支配. 该模型保留了高斯散射训练并重建了阴影并用单一的24步取样轨迹共同突出.

blocks.en: Our contribution is the integrated dynamic range expansion pipeline, rather than any single component, and its evaluation across clipping distributions. We evaluate on the 181-scene SI-HDR benchmark [ 13 ] , along with additional degradations applied to the same HDR references. The benchmark-oriented variant, ExpandDiff-B, achieves the best gain-aligned PU21-PSNR among the evaluated methods, exceeding the strongest competing method by a paired mean of 3.43 3.43 dB. ExpandDiff-P, trained with DCS, ranks second on that metric and exceeds the strongest competing method by 7.34 7.34 dB under two-sided clipping.
blocks.zh: 我们的贡献是综合的动态范围扩展管道,而不是任何单一的组成部分,以及对剪接分配的评估。 我们评价181场的SI-HDR基准[13],以及适用于同一HDR参考的其他退化情况。 以基准为导向的变体"ExplainDiff-B"在被评价方法中实现了最佳增益相配的PU21-PSNR,以3.43 3.43 dB的对比平均值超过了最强相配方法. ExplainDiff-P经过DCS的训练,在该度量表上排名第二,在双侧剪接下超过最强相配方法7.34 7.34 dB.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Single-image HDR reconstruction. Eilertsen et al. [ 1 ] reconstruct saturated highlights with a CNN. ExpandNet [ 14 ] combines features at multiple spatial scales, Santos et al. [ 3 ] use feature masking and perceptual supervision, and Liu et al. [ 15 ] learn to reverse the camera pipeline. Other methods synthesize exposure brackets and merge them into HDR [ 4 , 5 ] . These approaches establish synthetic degradation and recovery of under- and overexposure as training objectives. DCS samples shadow and highlight clipping levels in percentile space, controlling the fraction of affected pixels across scenes. We couple this training distribution with spatially guided diffusion and a perceptual prediction domain.
blocks.zh: 单图HDR重建. 艾勒特森等编. [1]用有线电视新闻网重建饱和亮相. 扩展网[14]结合了多空间尺度的地物, Santos等. [3] 使用特征口罩和知觉监督,而刘等. [15] 学会反相机管道。 其他方法综合了接触括号,并把它们合并入《人类发展报告》[4,5]。 这些办法将合成退化和恢复接触不足和过度接触确定为培训目标。 DCS在百分位空间中采样阴影并突出剪切水平,控制所受影响的像素分量跨场. 我们把这种培训分布与空间引导的传播和认知预测领域结合起来。

blocks.en: Diffusion-based inverse tone mapping. Dalal et al. [ 9 ] condition diffusion on an encoded latent of the input for LDR-to-HDR conversion, while Goswami et al. [ 10 ] incorporate semantic guidance. LEDiff [ 6 ] fuses exposure brackets from separate highlight and shadow denoisers in a pretrained LDR latent space. ExpandDiff instead predicts one HDR image in pixel space, reconstructing both clipping directions in the same sampling trajectory. ExpoCM [ 16 ] also handles different exposure regimes jointly, using exposure-aware consistency trajectories for one-step inference.
blocks.zh: 以传播为主的反向声调映射. 达拉尔等. [9] 附加条件:将输入编码为潜伏的传播用于LDR到HDR转换,而Goswami等人则将输入编码为潜伏的传播。 [10] 纳入语义指导。 LEDIff [6]在预受训练的LDR潜伏空间中从单独的亮度和阴影去除器中引信出暴露的括号。 扩展Diff反而在像素空间中预测出一幅HDR图像,在相同的采样轨迹上重建出两个剪接方向. ExpoCM[16]还联合处理不同的接触制度,使用接触感一致性轨迹进行单步推论.

blocks.en: Further discussion of related works is provided in the supplementary material.
blocks.zh: 有关工作的进一步讨论见补充材料。

blocks.en: 3 Method
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en: Fig. 1 summarizes ExpandDiff. We first construct a PU21 encoded HDR target and use Dynamic Clipping Synthesis (DCS) to synthesize its LDR guidance. A conditional diffusion model then learns to recover the perceptually encoded target. At inference, the LDR image guides a single sampling trajectory, and the predicted image is decoded to linear HDR.
blocks.zh: 图1总结了扩展 Diff。 我们首先构建了PU21编码的HDR目标,并使用动态剪接合成(DCS)来合成其LDR指导. 一个有条件的传播模型然后学习恢复有知觉被编码的目标. 推断出,LDR图像引导单一的采样轨迹,所预测的图像被解码为线性HDR.

blocks.en: Figure 1: ExpandDiff pipeline. Dynamic Clipping Synthesis varies the clipping levels of the LDR guidance during training, while PU21 encoding defines the HDR prediction domain. Spatial guidance conditions the diffusion network, and inverse encoding yields linear HDR.
blocks.zh: 图1:扩展Diff管道。 动态剪接合成在训练期间会改变LDR指导的剪接水平,而PU21编码则定义了HDR预测域. 空间指导为传播网络提供了条件,反向编码产生线性人类发展报告。

blocks.en: 3.1 Dynamic Clipping Synthesis
blocks.zh: 3.1 动态剪接合成

blocks.en: The clipping level of a real input is unknown at inference, and it differs with the exposure, the scene, and the camera. DCS varies the amount of information removed from shadows and highlights as training examples are constructed. This enables a single checkpoint to perform dynamic range expansion even when it receives images with varying degrees of degradation as input. For each HDR target Y Y , we synthesize the linear guidance image I = clip ⁡ ( Y , τ lo , τ hi ) − τ lo τ hi − τ lo . I=\frac{\operatorname{clip}(Y,\tau_{\mathrm{lo}},\tau_{\mathrm{hi}})-\tau_{\mathrm{lo}}}{\tau_{\mathrm{hi}}-\tau_{\mathrm{lo}}}. (1)

For each training example, DCS draws the clipping percentiles q lo ∼ 𝒰 ⁡ [ 0 , 10 ] q_{\mathrm{lo}}\sim\mathcal{U}[0,10] and q hi ∼ 𝒰 ⁡ [ 0 , 30 ] q_{\mathrm{hi}}\sim\mathcal{U}[0,30] , in percent. τ lo \tau_{\mathrm{lo}} is the q lo q_{\mathrm{lo}} percentile of the per-pixel channel minima, and τ hi \tau_{\mathrm{hi}} is the ( 100 − q hi ) (100-q_{\mathrm{hi}}) percentile of the per-pixel channel maxima. The same scalar thresholds apply to all channels. The percentiles control the fraction of affected pixels, allowing the training distribution to span near-unclipped through heavily clipped inputs across scenes with different intensity distributions. Neither the thresholds nor clipping masks are supplied to the network, so it must infer the required expansion from the LDR image itself.

blocks.en: For data, we use HDR images from Poly Haven, the public Laval photometric sample [ 17 ] , HDR-Real [ 15 ] , and Fairchild [ 2 ] . We form 512 × 512 512\times 512 images by center-cropping ordinary images and extracting five random perspective views from each panorama. Each resulting image is rescaled to a median luminance of 20 20 cd/m 2 and clipped at a peak of L max = 1000 L_{\max}=1000 cd/m 2 . Dividing by this peak gives a target Y ∈ [ 0 , 1 ] 3 × 512 × 512 Y\in[0,1]^{3\times 512\times 512} . This defines a consistent display-referred output scale.

blocks.en: 3.2 PU21 Prediction and the Bounded Head
blocks.zh: 3.2 PU21 预测和受限头

blocks.en: PU21 is a perceptually uniform encoding of absolute luminance [ 12 ] , where equal differences in its units are equally visible. We predict in the PU21 space and use it to supervise our model to exploit this property. PU21 is important for supervision, as in linear radiance, a perceptually equal error is numerically far larger in the highlights than in the shadows, so a pixelwise distance loss would be dominated by bright pixels. On PU21 values, each error instead counts according to its visibility.
blocks.zh: PU21是绝对发光度[12]的一种概念上统一的编码,其中其单位的等同差异同样可见. 我们预测在PU21空间,并用它来监督我们的模型来开发这个地产. PU21对监督很重要,如在线性光度中,一个知觉等同的误差在突起值上比在阴影中大得多,因此一个像素相距的丢失会由亮像素所主导. 在PU21值上,每个出错会根据其能见度进行计数.

We apply it per channel and normalize at the target peak: V ⁡ ( Y ) = U ⁡ ( L max ​ Y ) U ⁡ ( L max ) , x 0 = 2 ​ V ​ ( Y ) − 1 . V(Y)=\frac{U(L_{\max}Y)}{U(L_{\max})},\qquad x_{0}=2V(Y)-1. We decode the final prediction as Y ^ = V − 1 ​ ( ( x ^ 0 + 1 ) / 2 ) \hat{Y}=V^{-1}((\hat{x}_{0}+1)/2) ; the guidance I I remains linear.

This encoding changes the operating range of the tanh \tanh output head. With a linear target spanning 0 0 to 1000 1000 cd/m 2 , an intensity of 0.5 0.5 cd/m 2 maps to − 0.999 -0.999 , near the saturated tail of tanh \tanh . PU21 assigns more of the output range to dark intensities, placing them where tanh \tanh is more responsive, which improves the head’s sensitivity to shadow errors. We test the effects of the encoding and head jointly in Sec. 4.5 .

blocks.en: 3.3 Spatially Conditioned Diffusion Backbone
blocks.zh: 3.3 空间条件扩散后骨

blocks.en: HDR reconstruction must preserve visible structure while inferring content in clipped regions, motivating a pixel-space diffusion backbone with spatial LDR guidance at multiple resolutions. We adapt RAW-Diffusion’s conditional U-Net [ 7 ] from RAW Bayer prediction to HDR RGB prediction. An EDSR encoder [ 18 ] , without its upsampling head, extracts a full-resolution guidance feature map. SPADE layers [ 8 ] resample these features to each bottleneck and decoder resolution and predict spatial scale ( γ \gamma ) and shift ( β \beta ) maps. For a group-normalized activation h h , conditioning gives ( 1 + γ ⁡ ( I ) ) ⊙ h + β ⁡ ( I ) (1+\gamma(I))\odot h+\beta(I) . Thus, image structure is available throughout reconstruction without compressing the HDR prediction into a VAE latent space.

SPADE地层[8]将这些地貌重新标为每个瓶颈和解码分辨率,并预测空间尺度(γ\gamma)和移位(β\β)地圖. 对于组态活化活化h h, 条件给( 1 + + + → (一)) → h + β (一) ( 1 + γ (一))\odot h+\ (一) . 因此,在整个重建过程中都可以使用图像结构,而不将人类发展报告的预测压缩成一个VAE潜在空间。

The guidance encoder uses four residual blocks with 64 64 channels. ExpandDiff has 25.0 25.0 M parameters. We use 24 DDIM steps [ 19 ] ; both clipping directions are reconstructed by the same network and trajectory. An 8-bit inference input is linearized with the inverse of the sRGB transfer function, regardless of its original transfer function, and mapped into the range [ 0 , 1 ] [0,1] . The resulting image is approximately linear, even though the actual camera response is unknown.

blocks.en: 4 Experiments
blocks.zh: 4个实验

blocks.en: We compare ExpandDiff with published models on SI-HDR [ 13 ] , then test transfer across clipping levels and directions. A factorial ablation examines PU21 encoding and the bounded prediction head.
blocks.zh: 我们比较了扩展Diff和SI-HDR上公布的模型[13],然后测试跨剪辑级别和方向的传输. 一个因子衰减检查了PU21编码和受限的预测头.

blocks.en: 4.1 Evaluation Setup
blocks.zh: 4.1 评价设置

blocks.en: Data and conditions. SI-HDR provides 181 scenes with 1280 × 1888 1280\times 1888 HDR references. We center-crop and box-filter them to 512 × 512 512\times 512 , the input size used for all methods, as LEDiff [ 6 ] only accepts this size. We evaluate the benchmark’s supplied clip_95 inputs ( C 95 \mathrm{C_{95}} ) after the same crop and resize, in which 8.17 % 8.17\% of pixels have a channel at the ceiling and none at zero.

On average, 15.40 % 15.40\% of pixels are highlight-clipped, and 5.87 % 5.87\% are shadow-clipped. Every image contains both types of clipping. Thus, C 95 \mathrm{C_{95}} tests highlight reconstruction under the benchmark pipeline, while C p \mathrm{C_{p}} tests joint shadow and highlight reconstruction within the clipping ranges used by DCS. We also evaluate doubled clipping percentiles ( C p hard \mathrm{C_{p}^{hard}} ) and LEDiff’s independently defined degradation ( C 0 \mathrm{C_{0}} ) [ 6 , 20 ] ; details appear in the supplementary material.

blocks.en: Models. ExpandDiff-P is trained with DCS (Sec. 3.1 ); the P suffix denotes its percentile-based clipping distribution. ExpandDiff-B uses a benchmark-oriented degradation with a highlight-only clip at q hi ∼ 𝒰 ⁡ [ 3 , 7 ] q_{\mathrm{hi}}\sim\mathcal{U}[3,7] , an 8-bit round trip, and a randomized two-parameter response curve. They share data sources, architecture, target encoding, loss, and batch size 32 32 , but are trained for 150k and 75k steps at learning rates 2 × 10 − 4 2\times 10^{-4} and 10 − 4 10^{-4} , respectively. We compare with ExpandNet [ 14 ] , MaskHDR [ 3 ] , the highlight and shadow variants of LEDiff (HL and SH) [ 6 ] , and Refusion-HDR and DITM from AIM 2025 [ 21 ] , giving six configurations across five methods. We run the released models and include the unprocessed LDR input, a baseline many SI-HDR methods fail to improve on [ 13 ] . All methods receive the same 8-bit input for each condition, and all scores are computed in the same evaluation pipeline.

blocks.en: 4.2 Metrics and Alignment
blocks.zh: 4.2 计量和调整

blocks.en: We report PU21-PSNR, PU21-VSI, and PU21-PIQE, following the SI-HDR evaluation study [ 13 ] , together with HDR-VDP-3 [ 22 ] (v3.0.7, quality task, in JOD). ExpandDiff predictions are decoded to linear HDR first, so every method is encoded identically. We also report FID [ 23 ] on Reinhard-tone-mapped crops [ 24 ] , denoted FID-R, following LEDiff [ 6 ] . PSNR, VSI and HDR-VDP-3 measure agreement with the reference, whereas PIQE is no-reference and FID-R compares crop statistics, so neither necessarily ranks methods by reconstruction accuracy. Crop sampling details are given in the supplementary material.
blocks.zh: 我们报告PU21-PSNR、PU21-VSI和PU21-PIQE,这是继SI-HDR评价研究[13]之后,连同HDR-VDP-3[22](v3.0.7,质量任务,载于JOD)。 扩展Diff预测首先被解码为线性HDR,所以每种方法的编码都相同. 我们还报告FID [23] 关于Reinhard-tone-mapped 作物[24],表示FID-R,跟随LEDIff [6]. PSNR、VSI和HDR-VDP-3与参考一致,而PIQE则不作参考,FID-R则比较作物统计,因此不一定根据重建的准确性对方法进行排序。 作物取样详情见补充材料。

All metrics use the aligned prediction s ​ p sp . We additionally report full-reference metrics after SI-HDR’s ground-truth-fitted 20-parameter tone-and-color correction, labeled CRF [ 13 ] . The difference between the two columns shows how much error a more flexible tone-and-color fit reduces. These are evaluation-time alignments, applied independently to every method. Reported PSNR margins are paired means and can differ slightly from subtraction of rounded table entries.

blocks.en: 4.3 SI-HDR Benchmark
blocks.zh: 4.3 SI-HDR基准

blocks.en: On C 95 \mathrm{C_{95}} (Table 1 ), ExpandDiff-B reaches 22.61 22.61 dB gain-aligned PU21-PSNR, exceeding ExpandNet, the strongest competing model on this metric, by a paired 3.43 3.43 dB. ExpandDiff-P ranks second at 21.41 21.41 dB despite its different training degradation, with a paired advantage of 2.24 2.24 dB over ExpandNet. B also leads gain-aligned VSI and HDR-VDP-3, while P obtains the lowest PIQE. Together, the two variants attain the best values across all eight columns.
blocks.zh: 在C 95\mathrm{C_{95}} (表1)上,扩展Diff-B达到22.61 22.61 dB增益相通的PU21-PSNR,超过这个公分量上最强的相竞模型"扩展网",由一对3.43 3.43 dB. 扩展Diff-P在21.41 21.41分贝上排名第二,尽管其不同的训练退化,在扩展Net上拥有2.24 2.24分贝的对接优势. B还引导VSI和HDR-VDP-3对等,而P则获得最低的PIQE. 这两个变体合在一起,在所有8个栏中都达到了最佳值.

blocks.en: The advantage persists after CRF correction: ExpandDiff-B exceeds the strongest competing model by 1.64 1.64 dB PSNR, 0.0023 0.0023 VSI, and 0.09 0.09 JOD. ExpandDiff-P exceeds all competitors in corrected PSNR, although MaskHDR scores slightly higher in corrected VSI and HDR-VDP-3. The smaller PSNR margin after CRF correction indicates that tone and color differences contribute to B’s gain-only advantage, while its remaining lead supports an improvement beyond these correctable differences. The unprocessed input outperforms every competing model in gain-aligned PSNR, but both of our variants exceed it, and P improves on it in all eight columns. Since most input pixels remain unclipped, the strong input baseline emphasizes the need to preserve visible content while reconstructing missing information. The reported whole-image scores measure both effects. Fig. 2 shows two highlight-clipped examples. Additional qualitative results are in the supplementary material.
blocks.zh: 在通用报告格式修正之后,这一优势继续存在:扩展Diff-B超过最强的相竞模型: 1.64 1.64 dB PSNR、0.0023 0.0023 VSI和0.09 0.09 JOD。 扩展Diff-P超越了经更正的PSNR中的所有竞争者,尽管在经更正的VSI和HDR-VDP-3中MaskHDR得分略高. 通用报告格式校正后的较小的PSNR比值表明,音调和颜色差异有助于B的增益优势,而其剩余领先则支持在这些可更正差异之外作出改进。 未经处理的输入在收益对齐的PSNR中超越了每一个相竞的模型,但是我们两个变体都超过了它,P在所有8个列中都有改进. 由于大多数输入像素仍然未被剪切,强大的输入基线强调在重建缺失信息的同时需要保存可见内容. 所报告的全图像分数衡量两种效果. 图2显示两个突出显示的例子。 补充材料中还有其他质量结果。

blocks.en: 4.4 Clipping Severity and Distribution Transfer
blocks.zh: 4.4 剪接速度和分配传输

blocks.en: On C p \mathrm{C_{p}} (Table 1 ), ExpandDiff-P achieves 31.21 31.21 dB gain-aligned PSNR, a paired improvement of 7.34 7.34 dB over MaskHDR, and ranks first in every column except PIQE. Its HDR-VDP-3 and FID-R margins over the best competing models are 0.34 0.34 JOD and 2.11 2.11 , respectively. It also leads all three CRF-corrected metrics. The agreement across reference-based metrics supports improved fidelity under simultaneous shadow and highlight loss. DITM obtains a lower PIQE despite substantially lower PSNR, illustrating that no-reference quality and reconstruction accuracy can favor different outputs. Fig. 3 illustrates reconstruction on two examples when shadows and highlights are both clipped.
blocks.zh: 在C p\mathrm{C_{p}}(表1)上,扩展Diff-P实现31.21 31.21 dB增益对齐的PSNR,比Mask HDR对齐改进了7.34 7.34 dB,并在除PIQE以外的每栏中排名第一. 其HDR-VDP-3和FID-R在最佳竞争模式上的比值分别为0.34 0.34 JOD和2.11 2.11。 它还领导所有三个通用报告格式校正的衡量标准。 跨参考衡量标准的协议支持在同时阴影下提高忠诚度并突出损失。 DITM获得较低的PIQE,尽管PSNR大幅降低,说明没有参考质量和重建精度可以有利于不同的输出. 图3以两个例子说明重建情况,即阴影和亮点都被剪去。

blocks.en: As reported in the supplementary material, increasing the clipping percentiles to ( 10 , 30 ) (10,30) reduces P’s PSNR advantage to 4.76 4.76 dB, while it keeps a 0.33 0.33 JOD advantage in HDR-VDP-3. On LEDiff’s independently defined degradation, B leads the strongest competing model by 2.44 2.44 dB PSNR and 0.30 0.30 JOD. The harder clipping condition tests P at the upper endpoints of its training ranges, while LEDiff’s degradation tests a different input synthesis pipeline. The retained margins show that the gains are not confined to the midpoint clipping condition.
blocks.zh: 如补充材料所报告,将剪接百分位数提高至(10,30)(10,30)使P的PSNR优势降至4.76 4.76 dB,同时在HDR-VDP-3中保持了0.33 0.33 JOD的优势. 在LEDIff独立定义的降解上,B领先最强的相竞模型有2.44 2.44 dB PSNR和0.30 0.30 JOD. 更硬的剪接条件测试P在其训练范围的上端,而LEDiff的降解测试则是不同的输入合成管. 保留幅度表明,收益不仅限于中点剪接条件。

blocks.en: The P/B ranking reverses across input distributions: B leads P on seven metrics at C 95 \mathrm{C_{95}} , and P leads B on seven at C p \mathrm{C_{p}} . The comparison at their reported checkpoints also differs in training duration and learning rate. A matched-budget check at 75k steps gives P 21.38 21.38 dB PSNR on C 95 \mathrm{C_{95}} , still below B’s 22.61 22.61 dB. This supports matching the training degradation to the benchmark, while P’s second place demonstrates transfer from the DCS distribution.
blocks.zh: P/B排名在输入分布上反向: B在 C 95\mathrm{C_{95}}}中领先于P 7 公分;而 P 在 C p\mathrm{C_{p}}}中领先于B 7 公分. 所报检查站的比较在培训期限和学习率方面也有所不同。 在75k步的相匹配预算检查使得P 21.38 21.38 dB PSNR 在 C 95\mathrm{C_{95}}上,仍然低于B的22.61 22.61 dB. 这有助于将培训退化与基准相匹配,而P的第二位则表明从DCS分布转移。

blocks.en: 4.5 Target Encoding and Output Head
blocks.zh: 4.5 目标编码和输出头

blocks.en: We train all four combinations of linear or PU21 targets and bounded or unbounded heads for 150k steps, holding the remaining P configuration fixed. Table 2 shows that removing PU21 reduces gain-aligned PSNR by 2.00 2.00 dB, removing tanh \tanh by 1.01 1.01 dB, and removing both by 4.37 4.37 dB. The full model also leads the CRF-corrected fidelity metrics. Each component improves PSNR with either setting of the other component, supporting both choices within this architecture. Their combined benefit is consistent with the prediction-range argument in Sec. 3.2 , although the ablation does not separate the effects of perceptual error weighting and output sensitivity. This benefit is metric-dependent: the unbounded PU21 model has a slightly lower FID-R, and the unbounded linear model has the lowest PIQE.
blocks.zh: 我们训练所有4个组合的线性或PU21目标,以及有界或无界头等150k步,使剩下的P配置固定. 表2显示去除PU21会使增益对应于PSNR减少2.00 2.00分贝,去除tanh\tanh的比分为1.01 1.01分贝,去除两者的比分为4.37 4.37分贝. 完整的模型还导致通用报告格式校正的忠诚度指标。 每个部分都改进了PSNR,同时设置了其他部分,支持这一架构内的两种选择。 它们的综合效益与第3.2章中的预测-范围论证是一致的,虽然衰减并没有将知觉误差加权和输出敏感性的效果区分开来. 这个好处是依靠度量的:无约束的PU21模型的FID-R略低,无约束的线性模型的PIQE最低.

blocks.en: Inference cost. ExpandDiff takes 3.19 3.19 s per 512 × 512 512\times 512 image on an NVIDIA A100 80 GB with 24 DDIM steps. The fully convolutional network accepts other image sizes after reflection padding to multiples of 64, subject to available memory. Increasing sampling to 48 or 100 steps gives no clear PSNR improvement as reported in the supplementary material.
blocks.zh: 推论成本. 扩展Diff在一幅有24个DDIM步骤的NVIDIA A100 80 GB上取取出每512×512 512\times 512个图像. 完全分解的网络在反射后接受其他图像大小被多为64个,但以可用的内存为限. 如补充材料所报告,将取样增加到48个或100个步骤,没有明显的PSNR改进。

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: We introduced ExpandDiff, which couples Dynamic Clipping Synthesis, spatial LDR guidance, and perceptually encoded diffusion for joint shadow and highlight reconstruction. Its results across SI-HDR and additional clipping conditions show that a broadly sampled training distribution can transfer beyond its nominal degradation, while a benchmark-oriented distribution can further improve matched performance. The target ablation supports using PU21 with a bounded head for reconstruction fidelity. Like other methods, ExpandDiff cannot know the scene’s absolute brightness, and its reconstructions weaken over large contiguous clipped regions. Further limitations are discussed in the supplementary material.
blocks.zh: 我们引入了扩展Diff, 其中夫妇动态剪接合成, 空间LDR指导, 和感知编码的传播 为联合阴影和突出重建。 它在整个SI-HDR和额外剪接条件方面的结果表明,广泛抽样的培训分配可以超越名义上的退化,而以基准为导向的分配可以进一步改善相应的业绩。 目标衰竭支持使用有边框头的PU21来进行重建忠心. 与其它方法一样,ExploydDiff无法知道场景的绝对亮度,其重建在相接相接的被剪接的大区上空减弱. 补充材料讨论了其他限制。
